info.name: LI.FI Analytics API
info.description: LI.FI provides the best cross-chain swap across all liquidity pools and bridges.

item.name: Get all transactions for a wallet

header.description: Authentication header, register in the LI.FI Partner Portal (https://portal.li.fi/ ) to get your API Key.

query.description: (Required) Filter the transactions by integrator
A unix timestamp in seconds. No transaction older than this timestamp will be returned. If no value is passed, then the default value will be 30 days prior the current date.
A unix timestamp in seconds. No transaction newer than this timestamp will be returned.

item.name: Get the total amount of a token received on a specific chain, for cross-chain…

query.description: Pagination limit. Defines the maximum number of returned results.
The next page cursor. Must come from the `next` field of the response of the previous request.
The previous page cursor. Must come from the `previous` field of the response of the previous request.
(Required) A Unix timestamp in seconds marking the start of the query period, inclusive. Transactions older than this timestamp will not be included in the summary.

(Required) A Unix timestamp in seconds marking the end of the query period, inclusive. Transactions after this timestamp will not be included in the summary. **The maximum range supported by the endpoint is 30 days.**
(Required) The ID, or key of the chain on the receiving side of the transfer. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers received on the specified chain.
(Required) The address, or symbol of the token received in the transfers. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers involving the specified token on the receiving chain.
The ID, or key of the chain on the sending side of the transfers. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers sent from the specified chain.
The integrator string to filter transfers by. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers for the given integrator.

request.description: Calculates and returns the total received token amount per wallet address, per sending chain, within a specified time range, for a given receiving chain and receiving token. Only aggregates cross-chain transfers, meaning transfers with distinct sending and receiving chains.

query.description: Pagination limit. Defines the maximum number of returned results.
The next page cursor. Must come from the `next` field of the response of the previous request.
The previous page cursor. Must come from the `previous` field of the response of the previous request.
(Required) A Unix timestamp in seconds marking the start of the query period, inclusive. Transactions older than this timestamp will not be included in the summary.

(Required) A Unix timestamp in seconds marking the end of the query period, inclusive. Transactions after this timestamp will not be included in the summary. **The maximum range supported by the endpoint is 30 days.**
(Required) The ID, or key of the chain on the receiving side of the transfer. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers received on the specified chain.
(Required) The address, or symbol of the token received in the transfers. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers involving the specified token on the receiving chain.
The ID, or key of the chain on the sending side of the transfers. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers sent from the specified chain.
The integrator string to filter transfers by. This parameter filters the summary to include only transfers for the given integrator.

item.name: Get a list of filtered transfers

query.description: The integrator string to filter by
The sending OR receiving wallet address
The status of the transfers. Possible values are `ALL`, `DONE`, `PENDING`, and `FAILED`. The default is `DONE`
The oldest timestamp that should be taken into consideration. Defaults to 30 days ago
The newest timestamp that should be taken into consideration. Defaults to now
The chain where the transfer originates from.
The chain where the transfer ends.
The token transferred from the originating chain. To use this parameter `fromChain` must be set.
The token received on the destination chain. To use this parameter `toChain` must be set.

The chain where the transfer originates from.

The token received on the destination chain. To use this parameter `toChain` must be set.
